name: Original crypt Skeleton equips owned IronWarAxe and performs native onehand attacks

files.content:
replace=config
replace=data
resources="{resources}"
data="{oblivion_data}"
content=Oblivion.esm
start=ImperialDungeon01
skip-menu=1
new-game=0
no-grab=1
user-data="{output}/userdata"
data-local="{output}/test-data"
content=tutorial-passage-observer.omwscripts

[Video]
resolution x = 640
resolution y = 360
fullscreen = false
framerate limit = 60
[General]
screenshot format = png

[Input]
enable controller = true

[GUI]
controller menus = true

[Input]
camera sensitivity = 0.5

local self=require('openmw.self')
local core=require('openmw.core')
local Actor=require('openmw.types').Actor
local nearby=require('openmw.nearby')
local anim=require('openmw.animation')
local elapsed=0
local first=true
return {{engineHandlers={{onFrame=function(dt)
 elapsed=elapsed+dt;if elapsed<.5 then return end;elapsed=0
 local actor=nearby.getObjectByFormId(core.getFormId('Oblivion.esm',0x6c2e4))
 assert(actor and actor:isValid(),'Actual crypt Skeleton unavailable')
 local distance=(actor.position-self.position):length()
 print('CryptSkeleton sample pos='..tostring(self.position)..' target='..tostring(actor.position)..' distance='..distance..' player_health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(self).current..' skeleton_health='..Actor.stats.dynamic.health(actor).current..' dead='..tostring(Actor.isDead(actor)))
 assert(not Actor.isDead(self),'Player died during actual crypt Skeleton survey')
 if anim.hasAnimation(actor) then
  if first then
   for _,group in ipairs({{'idle','handtohandidle','onehandidle','bowidle','walkforward','handtohandforward','onehandforward','attackleft','handtohandattackleft','onehandattackleft'}}) do print('CryptSkeleton group '..group..' available='..tostring(anim.hasGroup(actor,group))) end
   first=false
  end
  print('CryptSkeleton aggression='..Actor.stats.ai.fight(actor).modified)
  print('CryptSkeleton active lower='..tostring(anim.getActiveGroup(actor,anim.BONE_GROUP.LowerBody))..' torso='..tostring(anim.getActiveGroup(actor,anim.BONE_GROUP.Torso)))
 end
end}}}}
